summary: Browser Use advertises $1 in free credits once per person for eligible Google, GitHub or Microsoft signups; no card required. Credits can pay for browser time ($0.02/hour, plus proxy traffic) and Browser Use Agents (model cost + 20% service fee). Top-ups start at $5; no subscription.
claim_steps: Sign up at https://browser-use.com using Google, GitHub or Microsoft; the $1 free credit is once per person and requires no card.
Check your dashboard for the advertised $1 free credit if eligible.
Use any awarded credits for browser time or agent runs; verify expiration in the account.
